comments.code:

comments.notes: BQN uses # or language-specific delimiters (% in MATLAB, ! in Fortran) for comments.

numbers.title: Vectors, Matrices & Numbers
numbers.notes: BQN is optimized for vector and matrix calculations with high-precision numerical representations.

booleans.title: Logical Vectors & Booleans
booleans.code:
is_valid = TRUE
flags = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
booleans.notes: BQN provides boolean types with support for element-wise vector logic operations.

type_casting.title: Type Coercion & Casting
type_casting.notes: BQN converts data between numeric, character, factor, and logical representations.

strings.title: Strings & Character Vectors
strings.notes: BQN treats strings as atomic character scalars or vector arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: BQN formats numerical output with sprintf formatting specifiers.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Switches
pattern_matching.notes: BQN executes branch logic via switch, ifelse, or conditional filtering.

range.title: Sequences & Indexing
range.notes: BQN indexes matrices and vectors using 1-based indexing and sequence generators.

iterators.title: Vectorized Apply & Iteration
iterators.notes: BQN emphasizes vectorized functional processing (apply, map) over explicit loops.

oop_classes.title: Object Systems & S3/S4
oop_classes.code:
# Object systems in BQN
obj = list(name = "Model", score = 0.95)
class(obj) = "metric"
oop_classes.notes: BQN uses class dispatch systems (S3/S4 in R, multiple dispatch in Julia) for data modeling.

lists.title: DataFrames & Lists
lists.notes: BQN stores heterogeneous columnar records in data frames and lists.

tuples.title: Pairs & Records
tuples.notes: BQN uses named vectors or lightweight structures for data records.

sets.title: Set Operations
sets.notes: BQN provides native mathematical set functions (union, intersect, setdiff).

modules_import.title: Libraries & Packages
modules_import.notes: BQN loads package namespaces using library or import declarations.
